body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and make the target Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target also suffers -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Execution
rider.html: If the target is Locked, you may end Lock when it next leaves cover before your next turn: it takes 1 weapon Damage after that movement. This rider resolves once.
